name: guide
description: A searchable troubleshooting and how-to knowledge base for Kiro Crew: find a fix by symptom or keyword, and let any agent query the same entries over MCP instead of guessing.
author: kirocrew
highlights: Search a curated troubleshooting and how-to knowledge base by symptom or keyword
Every entry lays out the exact commands to run and what to expect at each step
Agents look up the same fixes over MCP (guide_search / guide_get) instead of guessing
Internal editions add their own entries without changing what ships publicly
useCases: Look up the fix for a Kiro Crew problem by symptom or keyword, in the dashboard or from an agent over MCP.
configuration: Enable the app from the App Store; the public guide entries ship with it, and internal editions add their own via a data overlay.
